summary: 加州快餐$20(AB1228,2024)是当前最前沿的高相对水平实验,证据真实分歧:Berkeley报告加薪8-9%、价格升约1.5%、'无显著就业损失'且无削工时证据;反方(QCEW趋势调整)估计快餐就业降约3.2-3.6%(约1.8万岗位)。这恰是竞争理论与准实验张力的最新前线,尚未收敛。

evidence.title: Berkeley:无就业损失
evidence.quote: no negative effects on fast-food employment

evidence.title: 反方:就业降3.6%
evidence.quote: This approach, namely adjusting for the performance of other industries, suggests that AB 1228 reduced fast-food employment by 3.6 percent.
